title: Wajan Retak di Bulan Ini
subject: an old pandai besi in Kampung Tugu reforges the same widow's cracked frying pan every month, and slowly understands she cracks it on purpose to keep coming back to his forge
caption: Keroncong Tugu Portuguese-creole folk, unhurried waltz-leaning pulse. Bright strummed macina and ukulele cak-cuk rhythm, plucked acoustic guitar countermelody, bowed cello walking bass, soft wooden flute answering the voice. Dry wooden-room recording, tape warmth, light plate reverb. Female vocal, mid register, plain warm tone, conversational delivery with clear sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, G major. Teasing and tender mood. No drums, no electric guitar, no synths, no autotune, no dangdut flourish, no pop gloss.
lyrics:
[Intro - macina strum, flute]

[Verse 1]
Bu Ratmi datang bawa wajan retak
Tangannya pegang gagang yang sudah goyang
Kutaruh di bara, kupukul pelan-pelan
Bunyinya nyaring seperti nada do

[Pre-Chorus]
Sudah dua belas kali bulan ini
Besi yang kuat kok bisa pecah lagi

[Chorus]
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, wajan retak lagi
Kutempa sambil pura-pura marah
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, kutunggu lagi
Besinya kuat, hatiku yang goyah

[Verse 2]
Dia duduk di bangku dekat tungku
Cerita soal cucu dan harga minyak
Kukira api yang bikin panas begini
Ternyata dia yang tak mau pulang

[Pre-Chorus]
Kuperiksa retaknya di bawah lampu
Rapi sekali, lurus seperti garis

[Chorus]
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, wajan retak lagi
Kutempa sambil tak lagi pura-pura
Wajan retak lagi, Bu, kutunggu lagi
Besinya kuat, hatiku yang luluh

[Bridge - guitar and cello alone]
Kali ini tak usah dipukul dulu
Duduk saja, kopinya masih hangat

[Chorus]
Wajan tak retak, Bu, wajan tak retak
Kali ini kupanggil kau tanpa alasan
Wajan tak retak, Bu, tapi datanglah
Besi dan aku sama-sama menunggu

[Outro - flute, macina fades]
